criteria.description: the tool's options include "Reverse word order", off at first. With it on, the words of the text come out in reverse order and each word keeps its letters: "Hello big world" becomes "world big Hello".

failures.title: OMNI-1 reverse word order [OMNI-1][AC-1] reverses the order of words and keeps each word
failures.message: expected 'dlrow gib olleH' to be 'world big Hello' // Object.is equality

failures.title: OMNI-1 reverse word order [OMNI-1][AC-1] reverses word order of a longer single line
failures.message: expected 'evif ruof eerht owt eno' to be 'five four three two one' // Object.is equality

failures.title: e2e/OMNI-1.spec.ts @omni OMNI-1 [OMNI-1][AC-1] reverse word order is off at first and reverses words when on
failures.message: Error: expect(locator).toBeVisible() failed Locator: getByLabel('Reverse word order') Expected: visible Timeout: 5000ms Error: element(s) not found Call log: - Expect "toBeVisible" getByLabel('Reverse word order') with timeout 5000ms - waiting for getByLabel('Reverse word order')

criteria.description: with "Reverse word order" and "Process multi-line text" both on, the words of each line are reversed separately and the lines keep their order: "one two" on the first line and "three four" on the second become "two one" and "four three".

failures.title: OMNI-1 reverse word order [OMNI-1][AC-2] reverses words of each line separately, keeping line order
failures.message: expected 'owt eno\nruof eerht' to be 'two one\nfour three' // Object.is equality

failures.title: e2e/OMNI-1.spec.ts @omni OMNI-1 [OMNI-1][AC-2] with multi-line on, words of each line are reversed separately

criteria.description: with "Reverse word order" off, the tool still reverses the characters: "Hello World" becomes "dlroW olleH".

failures.title: OMNI-1 reverse word order [OMNI-1][AC-3] still reverses characters when the option is false
failures.message: expected 'dlroW olleH' to be 'World Hello' // Object.is equality
